title: Gateway identity-proof transcript duplicates its domain separator
description: Security review finding: rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs build_identity_proof_transcript() reserves capacity for DOMAIN||IID||challenge but appends IDENTITY_PROOF_DOMAIN twice. Internal tests pass only because signer and verifier share the same defective helper; independent GCP implementations following the documented canonical transcript will sign DOMAIN||IID||challenge and fail authentication against Rust. Correct the transcript to append the domain exactly once and add a fixed literal/vector oracle that does not call the production builder for expected bytes/signature.
